experiment: N5 discovery-only selective hybrid gate freeze

protocol.independent_unit: content group; exactly one row per group

gate.heldout_threshold_rule: route NLA iff score > threshold, or score == threshold and sha256(row_uid) <= tie_hash_cutoff_inclusive
gate.objective: maximize sum(KL_big-KL_hybrid)/sum(KL_zero) among feasible candidates; differences within 1e-6 choose smaller fraction
